subject.title: [Feature Request] Add option to disable 'new messages' notification banner in WebChat

question: Which WebChat indicator modes should be supported, and must every mode retain a visible or keyboard-accessible jump-to-latest action?
rationale: The current indicator is an intentional recovery affordance for preserved backscroll, so changing its visibility or replacement behavior requires explicit UX direction.

options.title: Compact or dismissible mode
options.body: Add a browser-local less-intrusive presentation while preserving a discoverable jump-to-latest action.

options.title: Fully hidden mode
options.body: Allow the indicator to disappear entirely, accepting reduced discoverability for unseen content below the viewport.

options.title: Keep current indicator
options.body: Decline a new preference and retain the existing catch-up affordance unchanged.

recommendation.title: Compact or dismissible mode
recommendation.body: Add a browser-local less-intrusive presentation while preserving a discoverable jump-to-latest action.

likelyOwner.reason: He already reviewed this exact product choice and kept it open for maintainer follow-up.
